name: RoleColorFinder
tagline: Know your team's RoleColor. Make every conversation count.
description: RoleColorFinder helps teams understand how each person leads, executes, and communicates. Connect RCF to ChatGPT and every response becomes personalized to your team's unique RoleColor composition, from hiring decisions to conflict resolution to communication coaching.

b2b.label: Business Portal
b2b.description: Company admins connect ChatGPT to the full team roster, RoleColor distribution, and hiring context.

personal.label: Personal Portal
personal.description: Individuals connect ChatGPT to their own RoleColor profile and optionally direct teammate context.

submission_notes: Business mode limits org-level tools to active admin/hr connections.
Personal mode limits access to the signed-in user's own profile and opted-in teammate context.
All tool calls are logged to chatgpt_tool_calls with sanitized inputs.
